jobDescription: Our analytics database is sold both as an on-premises product and as a hosted service, and it ships on a release train every two weeks. The Technical Program Manager for release engineering runs the release calendar, chairs the go/no-go meetings, tracks dependencies between the storage, query and console teams, and works to shorten the time a change waits between merge and release. Lead-time improvements are reported from the release tracker against a baseline quarter. The role also partners with the security team on the process for shipping urgent vulnerability fixes.
requirements: Runs a recurring release calendar and the go/no-go meetings for a multi-team software product.
Tracks cross-team dependencies and escalates blocked work to engineering directors.
Shows a measured reduction in merge-to-release lead time against a baseline quarter from the release tracker.
Coordinates the security-fix fast-track process and reports its use to customer account teams.
Holds a project management certification such as PMP or equivalent.

evidence.text: Ran the fortnightly release calendar for the database product at Corvid Data and chaired the go/no-go meeting with the leads of the storage, query and console teams.
Kept the dependency board for the three teams and raised blocked items at the weekly engineering directors' sync.
Introduced a merge-freeze checklist and an automatically drafted set of release notes; median merge-to-release lead time in the release tracker went from 19 days in Q1 2023 to 11 days in Q3 2023.
Agreed a fast-track route with the security team so that critical fixes could ship outside the train once the security lead approved them.
Earned the Project Management Professional (PMP) certification from the Project Management Institute in 2022.

Work sample: the Q3 2023 release review deck, with a per-release chart of median merge-to-release lead time from the tracker (Q1 2023 median 19 days, Q3 2023 median 11 days), a method slide defining lead time from merge commit to tagged release, and the VP of engineering's comments.
HR verification note: the candidate's PMP certificate was looked up on the Project Management Institute's online certification registry; it is listed as active, with renewal due in March 2027.
Recruiter logistics note: the candidate is available from 1 December and asked whether the role covers the Friday evening release window.

propositions.text: Median merge-to-release lead time in the release tracker went from 19 days in Q1 2023 to 11 days in Q3 2023, after the candidate introduced a merge-freeze checklist and automatically drafted release notes.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the change and both quarters, and the work sample carries the tracker chart and the lead-time definition.

propositions.text: The candidate holds the PMP certification, listed as active on the Project Management Institute's registry.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the certification and the HR note records the registry check.
